Container.Name: Mendil
Container.Overview: Song requests for your TeamSpeak 3 or 6 server. Someone types !play with a song, a YouTube link or a Spotify link in the channel chat, and Mendil plays it in the voice channel. It has a queue, internet radio for when the queue is empty, admin and listener roles from your server groups, and a web panel. This template uses the Classic engine: the official TeamSpeak 3 client runs headless in the container. The client is proprietary and is downloaded on first start, after you accept its license. Set TS3_HOST to your TeamSpeak server (this Unraid server's IP if TeamSpeak runs here too). The web panel password is in the container log on first start. Docs: https://ulaski.github.io/mendil/

Config.Name: Accept the TeamSpeak client license
Config.Description: Type accept to accept the license of the TeamSpeak 3 client (https://www.teamspeak.com/en/privacy-and-terms/). Mendil downloads the client on first start; it is not part of the image.

Config.Name: TeamSpeak server
Config.Description: Address of your TeamSpeak server: host name, IP or host:port.

Config.Name: TeamSpeak voice port
Config.Description: Voice port of the TeamSpeak server.

Config.Name: Server password
Config.Description: Only if your TeamSpeak server has a password.

Config.Name: Channel
Config.Description: Channel to join, by name or path (Games/Music). Empty means the default channel.

Config.Name: Channel password
Config.Description: Only if that channel has a password.

Config.Name: Admin unique IDs
Config.Description: Comma-separated TeamSpeak unique IDs of admins (type !whoami in TeamSpeak to see yours). Empty, together with Admin groups: everyone is an admin.

Config.Name: Admin groups
Config.Description: Comma-separated server group IDs of admins.

Config.Name: Web panel password
Config.Description: Admin password for the web panel. Empty: one is generated on first start and printed in the log. Everyone else signs in with their TeamSpeak nickname.

Config.Name: Radio stations
Config.Description: Internet radio for when the queue is empty, as name=stream address, comma-separated.

Config.Name: Radio station
Config.Description: A station name or stream address that plays whenever the queue is empty.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID Mendil runs as (Unraid: 99, nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID Mendil runs as (Unraid: 100, users).

Config.Name: Web panel
Config.Description: Port of the web panel. Reach it on your LAN; put it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS before exposing it to the internet.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The bot's identity (keep it, or server groups you gave the bot are lost), settings and saved queue.

Config.Name: TeamSpeak client
Config.Description: The downloaded TeamSpeak client, so it is not downloaded again after every update.
